messages:
mei: seeing a sudden IO backlog on ap-northeast1 cohort e-05. GPU attaches timing out for a few mins. storage-bot alerted.

storage-bot: ALERT cohort=e-05 metric=io_retry_rate delta=+66 window=7m threshold=30 flagged=[e-05-02,e-05-05]
dan_infra: oncall, can you paste dmesg?

mei: short snippet: 
[02:11:01] nvme0n1: read timeout, retrying
[02:11:07] nvme0n1: SMART Media Errors: 2
[02:11:12] k8s: attach timeout for pod gpu-train-xyz

olga_sre: immediate steps: 1) cordon affected hosts 2) reduce janitor concurrency to 2 for e-05 3) pause snapshot compaction for that AZ. that should lower tail latency.
dan_infra: executing: `kubectl cordon e-05-02 e-05-05` and patching cm `scratch-e05` to set `janitor.max_concurrency=2`.

mei: started isolated scrub on e-05-05. rerouting GPU pods to reserved pool (cost watch on).

storage-bot: NOTE scrub=started host=e-05-05 mode=isolated by mei

olga_sre: monitor nvme.media_errors and smart-critical; if media_errors delta > 8 in 30m open RMA batch.
dan_infra: scrub reduced retries quickly; uncordoning e-05-05 now. leaving e-05-02 cordoned for 40m.

mei: cost impact estimate ~USD 90 extra for reserved routing over 2h. will open spare parts precheck in case this repeats.
olga_sre: thanks, logging runbook updates about snapshot timing to avoid scrub overlap. end.
